newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian Norilsk Nickel chooses insurance agent.
newsitem.headline: Russian Norilsk Nickel chooses insurance agent.

text.p: Leading Russian metals group Norilsk Nickel has named ZAO Strakhovaya Kompaniya Interros-Soglasiye its general insurer for the next two years, the head of Interros-Soglasiye said on Friday.
The deal is part of Norilsk's 1997-98 strategy plan and contracts supporting it will be signed next month, chief executive Igor Zhuk told Reuters.
According to the strategy RAO Norilsky Nikel 0#NKEL.RUO will channel all its insurance payments through Interros-Soglasiye, Zhuk said.
If Norilsk needs a service Interros-Soglasiye cannot provide, it will look elsewhere, he said.
Interros-Soglasiye estimated the annual premium Norilsk Nickel may pay at 150 billion roubles ($26.6 million), Zhuk said.
Interros-Soglasiye will re-insure about 30 percent of the transport of export goods, or $3-$4 million, at Russia's second biggest insurer SAO Ingosstrakh, he said.
Interros-Solglasiye is an insurance company which is part of the Interros financial-industrial group set up by Uneximbank. Uneximbank owns a 38 percent share in Norilsk Nickel.
